body:
OWNER-DIRECTED ASSESSMENT AND SEQUENCING CORRECTION

Measured state at storymodel4s main e584ad6: the typed model, canonical StoryModelCodec, recall alignment, renderer-neutral Codex and Atlas views, and the StoryAtlas HTML/SVG renderer all exist. Exact current HEAD compiled and ran the public recall example in a clean archive. The missing product center is an orchestrating CLI and the agreed bundle. StoryAtlas currently accepts only edition --out and hard-wires War of the Ghosts; its storymodel4s pin is 266 commits behind current HEAD and it has no remote. The output epic and S1-S5 are open and unclaimed. Current full-court evidence is 39 commits behind HEAD.

CORRECTION: direct text input should not be blocked on Stage 1b. Accepting bytes, decoding text, constructing StorySource and SurfaceAtlas, and emitting intake receipts are deterministic capabilities we have now. What Stage 1b blocks is a validated semantic StoryModel, not input itself. The sound CLI accepts --in now and always emits source identity plus a typed scientific outcome: Validated when evidence-backed compilation succeeds, Draft or Partial with explicit gaps, or Refused or Unestablished when no semantic provider is available. It must never turn provider absence into an empty graph or researcher-reviewed authority.

PROPOSED FIRST VERTICAL SLICE: storyatlas4s inspect --in story.txt --out bundle. It emits manifest.json, source.txt, result.json, and self-contained preview.html immediately; storymodel.json and higher-order Codex or Atlas views appear only when validated semantics exist. In the surface-only state preview.html shows exact canonical text and surface spans plus a prominent semantics-unestablished account. A fixture or --model path exercises the full story, recall, and visualization path now. Raw intake and validated interpretation are separate stages in one user-facing workflow, not competing choices.

Priority: S1 plus S3 outcome contract, direct-text surface intake, static preview of available evidence, fixture/model full-path integration, recall posterior visualization, then Stage 1b provider for arbitrary semantic interpretation. This post records the assessment requested by the owner and the owner instruction to proceed.
